crossRefs.note: He said, “Naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked will I return there. Yahweh gave, and Yahweh has taken away.…
for when he dies he will carry nothing away. His glory won’t descend after him.
“But God said to him, ‘You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared—whose…
For we brought nothing into the world, and we certainly can’t carry anything out.

translations.web: As he came out of his mother’s womb, naked shall he go again as he came, and shall take nothing for his labor, which he may carry away in his hand.
translations.bsb: As a man came from his mother’s womb, so he will depart again, naked as he arrived. He takes nothing for his labor to carry in his hands.
translations.kjv: As he came forth of his mother's womb, naked shall he return to go as he came, and shall take nothing of his labour, which he may carry away in his hand.
translations.asv: As he came forth from his mother's womb, naked shall he go again as he came, and shall take nothing for his labor, which he may carry away in his hand.
